name: Gravity House Duology
source:
A double threat of short stories.

First, examine the tense, dangerous double-bind between a cynical social media figure and a teenage runaway in, "Prisoners in the Mirror," co-written by Joyce Fisher and Ophelia C. Green. Then, venture into the far, far future and experience the final chapter of life as we know it in, "Colony-Organism: Microbes of Love and Pain," written by Ophelia C. Green.

[From [url=https://gravity-house.itch.io/gravity-house-demo]itch.io[/url]]

(Note: previously called "Gravity House Demo" but was [url=https://gravity-house.itch.io/gravity-house-demo/devlog/991638/update-name-changed]changed[/url])
translation:
短篇小说的双重威胁。

首先，我们来看看乔伊斯·费舍尔和奥菲莉亚·C·格林合着的《镜中囚徒》中愤世嫉俗的社交媒体人物和离家出走的青少年之间紧张而危险的双重束缚。然后，冒险进入遥远的未来，体验我们所知道的生命的最后一章，《群体有机体：爱与痛苦的微生物》，作者：奥菲莉亚·C·格林。

[来自[url=https://gravity-house.itch.io/gravity-house-demo]itch.io[/url]]

（注：以前称为“重力屋演示”，但已[url=https://gravity-house.itch.io/gravity-house-demo/devlog/991638/update-name-changed]更改[/url]）
